name: voxforg
description: Hardware-adaptive neural speech synthesis workstation, voice cloning & visual pipeline engine

scripts.ui:build: npm --prefix ui run build && node -e "fs.rmSync('crates/voxforg-api/ui_dist', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('ui/dist', 'crates/voxforg-api/ui_dist', {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.build:all: npm run ui:build && cargo build --release --bin voxforg
